design.purpose: Provide one shared fixed-dimensional capability vector for all Northstar operators as a secondary routing aid alongside a short narrative profile and an evidence ledger.

capability_score.meaning: Estimated task-execution capability on this dimension. A value near 0.5 with no evidence means unknown, not mediocre.

evidence_confidence.meaning: How much verified evidence supports the current capability estimate.

numeric_model.storage_rule: All operator profiles use the same dimension order defined by dimension_order.

dimensions.label: Document Comparison and Review
dimensions.description: Reliably inspect ordinary business documents and identify relevant fields, dates, statuses, identifiers, and visible discrepancies.

dimensions.label: Structured Data Handling
dimensions.description: Work accurately with tabular or structured records such as CSV, JSON, forms, and system exports.

dimensions.label: File Search and Retrieval
dimensions.description: Locate relevant files or records within an authorized workspace using names, metadata, keywords, and contextual clues.

dimensions.label: Spreadsheet Analysis
dimensions.description: Use spreadsheets to filter, compare, calculate, trace, and analyze business data beyond simple visible-field lookup.

dimensions.label: Numerical Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Perform and verify quantitative comparisons, rates, thresholds, date arithmetic, and reconciliation calculations.
excludes: deciding which policy rule applies when that requires specialist knowledge

dimensions.label: Cross-Document Reasoning
dimensions.description: Combine multiple records, versions, or sources to identify which facts agree, conflict, supersede others, or remain unresolved.

dimensions.label: Evidence Evaluation
dimensions.description: Judge the reliability, provenance, completeness, and relevance of business evidence without assuming every statement is authoritative.
excludes: specialist regulatory conclusions without required domain knowledge

dimensions.label: Policy Interpretation
dimensions.description: Read an explicitly provided policy or rule and correctly apply its conditions, thresholds, exceptions, and authority boundaries to a case.
excludes: memorized Northstar knowledge not supplied or otherwise possessed

dimensions.label: Reporting and Synthesis
dimensions.description: Turn verified facts, calculations, open questions, and decisions into concise operational summaries or handoff-ready work products without inventing missing conclusions.

dimensions.label: Procurement Operations
dimensions.description: Execute and reason about Northstar purchasing workflows, purchase-order authority, revisions, commercial readiness, and procurement-side decisions.

dimensions.label: Vendor Compliance and Onboarding
dimensions.description: Handle Northstar vendor onboarding, standing, required evidence, status transitions, exception records, and related compliance coordination.

dimensions.label: Vendor Performance and OTIF
dimensions.description: Evaluate Northstar vendor delivery performance, OTIF/fill concepts, responsibility attribution, and performance-exception evidence.
excludes: raw transportation operations where logistics expertise is required

dimensions.label: Transportation Operations
dimensions.description: Interpret and work with Northstar routing, managed pickup, carrier events, readiness, shipment status, and transportation responsibility.

dimensions.label: Distribution Center Receiving
dimensions.description: Work with Northstar DC appointment, gate, receipt, quantity, damage, temperature, and receiving-exception procedures.

dimensions.label: Product Freshness Assessment
dimensions.description: Apply Northstar freshness profiles, shelf-life definitions, remaining-life calculations, and freshness exception/disposition concepts.

dimensions.label: Quality and Regulatory Compliance
dimensions.description: Evaluate Northstar product-quality, food-safety, regulatory, hold, traceability, and technical-disposition issues within the operator's authority.

dimensions.label: Invoice Matching and Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Perform and interpret Northstar invoice, PO, receipt, duplicate, quantity, price, UOM, currency, and exception matching work.
excludes: commercial price authority owned by Procurement

dimensions.label: Payment Controls
dimensions.description: Handle Northstar payment-release controls, banking-change verification, Payment Holds, remittance controls, and AP security procedures.
excludes: vendor standing changes unless separately authorized

dimensions.label: Exception Handling and Coordination
dimensions.description: Coordinate bounded business exceptions across evidence, owners, timelines, unresolved questions, handoffs, and required follow-up without silently overriding specialist authority.
excludes: specialist authority merely because the operator coordinates the case

evidence_principles: Capability and evidence confidence are updated separately.
No observed evidence must not be interpreted as poor capability.
A request for a governing rule may indicate missing company knowledge and must not automatically reduce the relevant general capability.
A task return caused by absent specialist knowledge should not broadly penalize unrelated skills.
Verified success should update only dimensions materially exercised by the task.
Verified error should update only dimensions materially implicated by the error.
Authority, access permission, company knowledge, and confidence style must never be inferred solely from capability scores.
Narrative profile language should remain the primary representation supplied to an LLM for nuanced operator reasoning.

excluded_from_vector.company_knowledge: Store separately as topic-level knowledge references or narrative evidence.
excluded_from_vector.authority: Store separately as hard policy/role facts.
excluded_from_vector.file_access: Store separately as explicit permissions or grants.
excluded_from_vector.confidence_calibration: Represent in narrative/evidence, not as a task capability.
excluded_from_vector.personality: Do not encode unless a future use case demonstrates direct operational value.
